name: FR_ST_IDLE
meaning: carried (anim 6) or lying on the ground (anim 7)

name: FR_ST_CASTING
meaning: msg 0x15 (held-state begin): anim 0; at the anim end -> 2 plus BeginFishing

name: FR_ST_FISHING
meaning: line out: anim 1 loop, or 2/3/4 via msg 0x10

name: FR_ST_RETRACTING
meaning: msg 0x16 while fishing: EndFishing, anim 5; at the anim end -> 0 with anim 6
